runtime_role_statement: Codex carrying the independent Ledger reviewer role
transport_events: A first Codex launch entered the CLI self-update path; the assignment prompt was buffered and, after the updater exited, was parsed by the shell instead of Codex.

The shell reported 'Execute: command not found' and parsed the trailing prose clause as a capitalized nonexistent 'Hermes' command, also returning command not found; no Hermes runtime was started, contacted, probed, or dispatched.
Codex was restarted and verified interactively before the assignment was resent.
The exact read-only assignment completed without repository modification or another runtime invocation.

transport_incident.summary: Herdr reported the initial Codex updater as ready; prose reached the shell after updater exit. The assignment was safely resent only after a verified Codex restart.
